scope: A numerical research checkpoint and cryptographic identities, not a complete executable or waveform archive.
recording_unit: Five fixed LibriSpeech excerpts; pitch, seed and variant conditions share these recordings.

input_attribution.citation: V. Panayotov, G. Chen, D. Povey, S. Khudanpur. LibriSpeech: An ASR Corpus Based on Public Domain Audio Books. ICASSP, 2015.
input_attribution.upstream_sources: LibriVox audiobook recordings and Project Gutenberg texts
input_attribution.research_modifications: Fixed source excerpts up to six seconds, float64 storage, PML resynthesis at -3/0/+3 semitones, unseparated high-band envelope transfer ablations, and numerical acoustic observations. This checkpoint exports existing numerical observations and hashes without new synthesis or waveform remeasurement. Audio and sample arrays are not included.
input_attribution.endorsement: No endorsement by the authors, distributors, readers, or source projects is implied.

observer.event_reference: Original fixed strong-region 95th percentile band power P_star
observer.crossing: first observer center at or above threshold within the fixed search region; no interpolation

fixed_configuration.same_recording_pitch_seed_randomness: The variants use the same generator, initial seed and draw sequence. Equal seeds across different pitch shifts do not imply equal noise at absolute times.

repeat_execution_comparison.interpretation: Independent repeat execution under the same fixed conditions reproduced all 90 NPY file hashes. This is deterministic reproduction of 90 conditions on five recordings, not 180 independent conditions or recordings.

public_context.topic: aHM and Cartesian-editing multimetric research guide

projection.included: All 90 supplied row-level scalar observations, all 90 original-relative crossing supplements, five fixed original event definitions, nulls and unavailable statuses, condition-level artifact hashes, fixed-input and scientific source hashes.
projection.consequence: The retained hashes identify the saved evidence but cannot regenerate omitted artifacts. This Git checkpoint by itself is not a self-contained reproduction package.
